senses.gloss: ? adrākṣaṇīya, Senartʼs em. at Mv 〔ii.152.14〕; explained in note as hyper-Skt. for Pkt. *a-dakkhaniya, read ˚ṇiya, ugly, = adekṣiya, q.v.; in description of the sick man as seen by the young Bodhisattva; Senart, ˚ṇīyo saṃvegakārako; mss. adrākṣāṇī (v.l. ayakṣāni)-ṣoḍaśa-vegakārako. Uncertain.
